components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Tertiary action adjacent to a primary. Also used as full-width CTA at card footer.

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Inline pill for event type, assignment status, song list state. Optionally includes a leading status dot.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-badge--brand { background: #eef2ff; color: #4f46e5; } .ds-badge--brand .ds-badge-dot { background: #6366f1; } .ds-badge--success { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; } .ds-badge--success .ds-badge-dot { background: #22c55e; } .ds-badge--warning { background: #fef9c3; color: #854d0e; } .ds-badge--warning .ds-badge-dot { background: #eab308; } .ds-badge--destructive { background: #fef2f2; color: #991b1b; } .ds-badge--destructive .ds-badge-dot { background: #ef4444; } .ds-badge--default { background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; } .ds-badge--default .ds-badge-dot { background: #64748b; }

narrative.overview:
Alabanza IBG is designed as a faithful record-keeping instrument — precise, unembellished, and immediately legible. Every screen is organized like a ledger entry: clear columns, deliberate weight hierarchy, and an absence of visual noise. The brand color is used sparingly, like ink from a fountain pen: it marks what matters and recedes everywhere else.

The system operates in two registers simultaneously: a composed light mode for desktop preparation during the week, and a deep dark mode that feels equally grounded and calm. Both feel like the same tool; neither feels like a consumer app. The overall density is comfortable — not sparse, not cramped — because worship team members need to scan quickly, see what's assigned, and move on with their preparation.

This is a tool built with reverence. Not reverence as decoration, but reverence as a design constraint: the UI should never compete for attention with the music being prepared.
keyCharacteristics: Clean, column-organized layouts with deliberate negative space
Indigo as the single accent — rare enough to feel meaningful
Geist as the system font: neutral, technically precise, legible at every weight
Restrained components: barely-there shadows, contained corner radii, no superfluous ornament
Full dark mode parity; both themes feel equally considered
Status badges as the primary color surface — event types, assignment statuses, song list states

rules.name: The Ledger Ink Rule
rules.body: Ministerial Indigo appears on ≤15% of any given screen surface. It marks the one action or the one state that matters. Saturating the page in indigo inverts its function.

rules.name: The Semantic Boundary Rule
rules.body: Green, yellow, red, and blue are status signals only. They are never used as decorative accents, background washes, or brand expressions.

rules.name: The Tight Headline Rule
rules.body: Negative letter-spacing (−0.025em to −0.01em) applies exclusively to semibold headings. Body and label text never receives negative tracking.

rules.name: The Resting Whisper Rule
rules.body: Cards are never perfectly flat. The ambient card shadow (shadow-sm) is a design constant on all Card surfaces at rest.

rules.name: The No-Sharp Rule
rules.body: Zero-radius corners are never used on visible surfaces. The minimum radius for any user-facing container or interactive element is 6px.

dos: Do use Ministerial Indigo (#4f46e5) exclusively for the single most important interactive element on each screen — the primary button or active nav item.
Do express every entity status (assignment status, event type, song list state) as a status badge with a leading dot.
Do use negative letter-spacing on semibold headings: −0.025em for Display, −0.015em for Headline, −0.01em for Title.
Do apply shadow-sm to all Card components at rest as a design constant, not a state.
Do use rounded-xl (16px) for all card containers and rounded-lg (12px) for interactive buttons.
Do write all UI copy in natural, warm Spanish. Error messages, empty states, loading states — all Spanish.
Do preserve full dark mode parity: every component that has a light style must have a tested dark style.
donts: Don't use semantic status colors (green, amber, red, blue) for decorative or brand purposes. They communicate state only.
Don't use sharp corners (0px radius) on any visible UI surface.
Don't apply neutral tracking or positive tracking to semibold headings.
Don't layer more than two accent colors on the same screen view. Indigo + Amber is the maximum.
Don't use the logo image (ibglogo.png) inline in UI components. The Music icon in the branded indigo square is the app's UI mark.
Don't invent testimonials, statistics, or social proof. No content that doesn't exist in the actual data model.
Don't use shadows heavier than Hover Lift on any resting surface — only modals and dropdowns earn Elevated shadow.
